t: Beyond 40 In Tech: Wisdom, Craftsmanship & AI
s: This article argues that experience in tech, particularly post-40, fuels a unique capability to leverage AI for personal knowledge management (Pipulate) and intellectual augmentation, favoring craftsmanship over management.
sub: Personal knowledge management via a single text file and AI.
AI as a tool to activate book knowledge into mentors.
Aging in tech as an advantage for wisdom and capability.
Craftsmanship path: using AI as 'intelligent subcontractors' (Pipulate).
Human agency in directing AI for 'WhatToDo' and 'HowToDo'.
